properties.description: Located in the Mazarron region it was a huge mining area as indicated by the archaeological remains of buildings, workings and mining waste (over 2.4 million tons). It had galleries measuring over 2 km in length. It was opened in the Republican period and was leased to mining companies.
properties.notes: Five ingots of the societas argentifodinarum Ilucronensium found here in the early 20th c.
